intro: US aid, fishing licences and a ship registry support the economy.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: The Marshall Islands has one of the world's largest ship registries. Tuna fishing licences and copra also bring income.

chapters.title: Trust fund
text: A trust fund is meant to replace aid over time.

keyTerms.meaning: A country's list of ships flying its flag.

cardGroups.title: Made in the Marshall Islands
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things the Marshall Islands makes and sells to the world.
